subject: Getting intermediate leapfrog steps, other implementation details

messages.author: e841a02cfc08fd49
messages.subject: Getting intermediate leapfrog steps, other implementation details
parts:
Hi list,

so I was wondering wether it was possible in STAN to get intermediate leapfrog steps from the HMC/NUTS sampler, for example to do something like Nishimura & Dunson. Also, is it still the case that STAN estimates the diagonal of the target covariance from burn-in as in the NUTS paper? Or is it approximating the full rank matrix now? Other notable differences from the NUTS paper?

Thanks
Ingmar

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Getting intermediate leapfrog steps, other implementation details
parts:
Please consult the manual regarding the tuning of the mass matrix,
in particular the “metric” argument.

See Sections 1.2.2, 2.2, and the last paragraph of 5 in 
http://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00225 for the general theory of why marginalizing
over trajectories is good and how we would do it in Stan.  We do not have 
an immediate plan to implement this due to the fact that the improvements 
are only moderate and introduce nasty I/O complications.
